theorem forward_fresh (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (i : List Bool) (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) (L : QueryLog (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n))) (hfresh : ∀ e ∈ L, queryHash H S n i e.2.1 ≠ queryHash H S n i (splitBits a).1) : ∀ e ∈ L.map (forwardEntry H S n i), e.2.1 ≠ (splitBits (forwardOutput H S n i a)).1

theorem forward_prob_transcript (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk sk : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((HashSignForward.handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (c : OracleComp (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)) (Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool)) (hc : c.CostBoundedBy (fun _ => 1) 1) : ProbComp.prob ((simulate (origFixedSign S n sk rs).withLog ((simulate ((HashSignForward.handler H S).impl n pk ω) c ((HashSignForward.handler H S).init n)).bind (fun res => (HashSignForward.handler H S).finish n pk ω res.2 res.1)) ((), [])).bind (fun res => .pure (padFin (S.msgLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) (List.ofFn res.1), res.2))) (OriginalSuccess S n pk) = ProbComp.prob (simulate (fixedSign H S n sk (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)) rs).withLog c ((), [])) (ForwardSuccess H S n pk (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)))

theorem forward_transcript (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk sk : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((HashSignForward.handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (c : OracleComp (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)) (Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool)) (hc : c.CostBoundedBy (fun _ => 1) 1) : ∃ (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) (L : QueryLog (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n))), simulate (fixedSign H S n sk (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)) rs).withLog c ((), []) = .pure (a, ((), L)) ∧ simulate (origFixedSign S n sk rs).withLog ((simulate ((HashSignForward.handler H S).impl n pk ω) c ((HashSignForward.handler H S).init n)).bind (fun res => (HashSignForward.handler H S).finish n pk ω res.2 res.1)) ((), []) = .pure (handlerOutput H S n (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)) a, ((), L.map (forwardEntry H S n (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)))))
def handlerOutput (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (i : List Bool) (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) : Fin ((HashSignForward.handler H S).outLen.eval n) → Bool

theorem handlerOutput_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (i : List Bool) (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) : handlerOutput H S n i a = fun j => forwardOutput H S n i a (Fin.cast (HashSignForward.handler_output_width H S n) j)

theorem handler_finish_output (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((HashSignForward.handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) (s : Fin ((HashSignForward.handler H S).stateLen.eval n) → Bool) (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) : (HashSignForward.handler H S).finish n pk ω s a = .pure (handlerOutput H S n (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)) a)

theorem ofFn_handlerOutput (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (i : List Bool) (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) : List.ofFn (handlerOutput H S n i a) = List.ofFn (forwardOutput H S n i a)
def origFixedSign (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk : List Bool) (rs : S.sign.Coins n) : QueryImpl (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => S.msgLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)) Unit unifSpec

theorem origFixedSign_apply (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk : List Bool) (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (j : Fin 1) (m : Fin (S.msgLen.eval n) → Bool) (s : Unit) : origFixedSign S n sk rs j m s = .pure (padFin (S.sigLen.eval n) (S.sign.runAt n (pairEncode sk (List.ofFn m)) rs), ())

theorem origFixedSign_eq (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk : List Bool) (rs : S.sign.Coins n) : origFixedSign S n sk rs = fun _ m _ => .pure (padFin (S.sigLen.eval n) (S.sign.runAt n (pairEncode sk (List.ofFn m)) rs), ())

theorem origFixedSign_queryHash (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (sk i : List Bool) (rs : S.sign.Coins n) (m : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) : origFixedSign S n sk rs 0 (queryHash H S n i m) () = .pure (hashedReply H S n sk i rs m, ())

theorem originalSuccess_forwardOutput (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk i : List Bool) (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) (L : QueryLog (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n))) : OriginalSuccess S n pk (forwardOutput H S n i a, ((), L.map (forwardEntry H S n i))) ↔ ForwardSuccess H S n pk i (a, ((), L))

theorem originalSuccess_iff (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk : List Bool) (res : (Fin (S.msgLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) × (Unit × QueryLog (bitSpec (fun _ : Fin 1 => S.msgLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n)))) : OriginalSuccess S n pk res ↔ S.Accepts n pk (splitBits res.1).1 (splitBits res.1).2 ∧ ∀ e ∈ res.2.2, e.2.1 ≠ (splitBits res.1).1
def queryHash (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (i : List Bool) (m : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) : Fin (S.msgLen.eval n) → Bool

theorem queryHash_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (i : List Bool) (m : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) : queryHash H S n i m = padFin (S.msgLen.eval n) (H.eval (atParam n (pairEncode i (List.ofFn m))))
def advWord (H : CRH) (w : List Bool) : List Bool
theorem advWord_eq (H : CRH) (w : List Bool) : advWord H w = pairEncode (pairFstD (pairSndD w)) (indexWord H (pairFstD w) (pairSndD (pairSndD w)))

theorem exists_forwardMachine (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (A : NUPPT) : ∃ C : NUPPT, ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ φ : (Fin ((handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) × A.Coins n ≃ C.Coins n, ∀ (pk : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) (r : A.Coins n), (simulate ((handler H S).impl n pk ω) (A.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun _ : Fin 1 => H.domLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n) (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n)) n 1 ((handler H S).advInput n pk ω) r) ((handler H S).init n)).bind (fun res => (handler H S).finish n pk ω res.2 res.1) = C.toCompOn (bitCodec (fun _ : Fin 1 => S.msgLen.eval n) (fun _ => S.sigLen.eval n) ((handler H S).outLen.eval n)) n 1 pk (φ (ω, r))
def finalWord (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (w : List Bool) : List Bool

theorem finalWord_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (w : List Bool) : finalWord H S w = pairEncode [true] (hashWord H S (rU w) (indexWord H (rU w) (rW w)) ((finA w).take (H.domLen.eval (rU w).length)) ++ (finA w).drop (H.domLen.eval (rU w).length))
def handler (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) : InteractiveHandler 1 (fun _ => H.domLen) (fun _ => S.sigLen) 1 (fun _ => S.msgLen) (fun _ => S.sigLen)

theorem handler_advInput (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) : (handler H S).advInput n pk ω = pairEncode pk (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω))

theorem handler_finish (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) (s : Fin ((handler H S).stateLen.eval n) → Bool) (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) : (handler H S).finish n pk ω s a = .pure (padFin ((handler H S).outLen.eval n) (hashWord H S (List.replicate n true) (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)) ((List.ofFn a).take (H.domLen.eval n)) ++ (List.ofFn a).drop (H.domLen.eval n)))

theorem handler_finish_split (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) (s : Fin ((handler H S).stateLen.eval n) → Bool) (a : Fin (H.domLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n) → Bool) : (handler H S).finish n pk ω s a = .pure (fun j => Fin.append (padFin (S.msgLen.eval n) (H.eval (atParam n (pairEncode (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)) (List.ofFn (splitBits a).1))))) (splitBits a).2 (Fin.cast (handler_output_width H S n) j))

theorem handler_impl (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (pk : List Bool) (ω : Fin ((handler H S).seedLen.eval n) → Bool) (i : Fin 1) (x : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) (s : Fin ((handler H S).stateLen.eval n) → Bool) : (handler H S).impl n pk ω i x s = .query 0 (padFin (S.msgLen.eval n) (H.eval (atParam n (pairEncode (H.gen.runAtL n [] (List.ofFn ω)) (List.ofFn x))))) fun y => .pure (y, s)
theorem handler_output_width (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) : (handler H S).outLen.eval n = S.msgLen.eval n + S.sigLen.eval n
def hashWord (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (u i m : List Bool) : List Bool
theorem hashWord_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (u i m : List Bool) : hashWord H S u i m = padStr S.msgLen u (H.eval (pairEncode u (pairEncode i m)))

theorem hashWord_eq_hash (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (hlen : ∀ n, H.rangeLen.eval n = S.msgLen.eval n) (n : ℕ) (i : List Bool) (x : Fin (H.domLen.eval n) → Bool) : hashWord H S (List.replicate n true) i (List.ofFn x) = List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (S.msgLen.eval n) => H.hash n i x (Fin.cast (hlen n).symm j))

theorem hashWord_unary (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (n : ℕ) (i m : List Bool) : hashWord H S (List.replicate n true) i m = List.ofFn (padFin (S.msgLen.eval n) (H.eval (atParam n (pairEncode i m))))
def indexWord (H : CRH) (u ω : List Bool) : List Bool
theorem indexWord_eq (H : CRH) (u ω : List Bool) : indexWord H u ω = H.gen.output (NUPPT.layout u [] [] ω)
theorem indexWord_unary (H : CRH) (n : ℕ) (ω : List Bool) : indexWord H (List.replicate n true) ω = H.gen.runAtL n [] ω
theorem polyTimeComputable_advWord (H : CRH) : PolyTimeComputable (advWord H)
theorem polyTimeComputable_finalWord (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) : PolyTimeComputable (finalWord H S)

theorem polyTimeComputable_hashWord (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) {u i m : List Bool → List Bool} (hu : PolyTimeComputable u) (hi : PolyTimeComputable i) (hm : PolyTimeComputable m) : PolyTimeComputable fun w => hashWord H S (u w) (i w) (m w)
theorem polyTimeComputable_indexWord (H : CRH) {u ω : List Bool → List Bool} (hu : PolyTimeComputable u) (hω : PolyTimeComputable ω) : PolyTimeComputable fun w => indexWord H (u w) (ω w)
theorem polyTimeComputable_roundWord (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) : PolyTimeComputable (roundWord H S)
def roundWord (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (w : List Bool) : List Bool

theorem roundWord_eq (H : CRH) (S : SignatureScheme) (w : List Bool) : roundWord H S w = if decide (rL w = []) then pairEncode [false] (pairEncode [] (hashWord H S (rU w) (indexWord H (rU w) (rW w)) (rX w))) else pairEncode [true] (rAns w ++ rS w)
theorem eq_pure_of_cost_zero {ι α : Type} {spec : OracleSpec ι} (c : OracleComp spec α) (h : c.CostBoundedBy (fun _ => 1) 0) : ∃ a, c = .pure a

theorem one_query_cases {ι α : Type} {spec : OracleSpec ι} (c : OracleComp spec α) (h : c.CostBoundedBy (fun _ => 1) 1) : (∃ a, c = .pure a) ∨ ∃ (i : ι) (x : spec.dom i) (f : spec.rng i → α), c = .query i x (fun y => .pure (f y))

theorem expect_simulate_sample_once {ι α R : Type} {spec : OracleSpec ι} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R] (ans : ∀ i, spec.dom i → R → spec.rng i) (c : OracleComp spec α) (hc : c.CostBoundedBy (fun _ => 1) 1) (g : α × (Unit × QueryLog spec) → ℝ) : ProbComp.expect (simulate (QueryImpl.ofComp (σ := Unit) (fun i x => (ProbComp.sample R).bind fun r => .pure (ans i x r))).withLog c ((), [])) g = ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample R) (fun r => ProbComp.expect (simulate (QueryImpl.withLog (fun (i : ι) (x : spec.dom i) (_ : Unit) => (OracleComp.pure (ans i x r, ()) : ProbComp (spec.rng i × Unit)))) c ((), [])) g)
